problem:
A partitioned matrix $M$ contains the following blocks: 

- ${M}_{12},$ which is a $2\times 1$ block

- ${M}_{21},$ which is a $2\times 3$ block

- ${M}_{22},$ which is a $2\times 1$ block

What are the dimensions of ${M}_{11}?$

A partitioned matrix $M$ contains the following blocks: 

- ${M}_{11},$ which is a $3\times 2$ block

- ${M}_{12},$ which is a $3\times 1$ block

- ${M}_{22},$ which is a $2\times 1$ block

What are the dimensions of the block ${M}_{21}?$
feedback.worked_solution:
We have a matrix of the form

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}{M}_{11} & {M}_{12} \\ {M}_{21} & {M}_{22}\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}3\times 2 & 3\times 1 \\ ?\,\times \,? & 2\times 1\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}∗ & ∗ & ∗ \\ ∗ & ∗ & ∗ \\ ∗ & ∗ & ∗ \\ ∗ & ∗ & ∗ \\ ∗ & ∗ & ∗\end{aligned}].
$$

Therefore, ${M}_{21}$ is a $2\times 2$ block.
